Armed Forces May Increase Agniveer Retention Beyond Initial 25%

The Indian Army, Navy, and Air Force are reportedly considering increasing the percentage of Agniveers retained beyond their initial four-year tenure, a move that could significantly alter the structure of the armed forces. The initial Agnipath scheme allowed for 25% retention, but as the first batches approach the end of their service, this review is underway. The potential expansion aims to address the armed forces' needs for experienced personnel.
